summary: Assess AI evidence, interpret model metrics and set practical oversight. Explore the five-day course and strengthen your decision review process.
lede: Data literacy for AI-driven decision making helps non-technical leaders evaluate the data and evidence behind AI-supported recommendations. It is for department heads, programme leads and functional managers who need to scrutinize recommendations without building models or writing code. They practise checking data quality, interpreting model metrics and thresholds, and setting risk ownership and human review, then record the reasoning in a decision brief or oversight log.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for leaders who review data-supported recommendations, sponsor AI use or are accountable for decisions that rely on analysis. It suits professionals who need to challenge evidence and set workable oversight without building models or writing code.
modules: AI Decision Questions and Data Boundaries
AI Decision Brief and KPI Review
prerequisites: Working experience reviewing business measures, reports or operational decisions is recommended. No coding or programming is required; exercises focus on interpreting sample metrics and drafting leadership artefacts.
